# contract: 04_kicad/

**Purpose** — the KiCad project. **Generated from `03_src/`, committed anyway**,
because a diff on a generated `.kicad_sch`/`.kicad_pcb` is how a generator bug
becomes visible before it becomes a physical defect.

**Mutability** — regenerated by `03_src/`. Hand-edits are legal but must be
adopted back into `03_src/` immediately (see below).

## Allowed

| Pattern | What | Written by |
|---|---|---|
| `<board>.kicad_sch` | schematic | `03_src/generate_schematic.py` |
| `<board>.kicad_pcb` | board | `03_src/generate_board.py`, then routing/edits |
| `<board>.kicad_pro` | project + netclasses | netclasses from `03_src/generate_rules.py`; rest is KiCad's |
| `<board>.kicad_dru` | custom rules incl. width floors | `03_src/generate_rules.py` |
| `fp-lib-table` / `sym-lib-table` | library refs — `${KIPRJMOD}` only | hand |
| `contracts.md` | this file | |

## Forbidden

- `*.kicad_pcb-bak`, `*-backup/`, `_autosave-*` → gitignore them.
- **A second board file.** `board_krt_experiment.kicad_pcb` sat beside the
  real board for weeks; nothing indicated which was authoritative. One board
  file. Experiments go in `06_build/` or a branch.
- Derived outputs (netlist, PDF, PNG, gerbers) → `06_build/`.
- Hand-editing `.kicad_dru` or the `.kicad_pro` netclasses. They are
  GENERATED from `03_src/rules/nets.yaml`.

## The hand-edit rule

The board is generated but also *routed and repaired* interactively — that is
normal and expected. The rule is: **any hand-edit that changes design intent
must be reflected in `03_src/` before the next regeneration**, or the next run
silently reverts it. Geometry (routing, pours) lives in the board file and is
NOT expected to round-trip through the generator; intent (nets, values,
footprints, rules) must.

## Validate

- exactly one `*.kicad_pcb` and one `*.kicad_sch`
- `kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones --schematic-parity` →
  0 violations, 0 unconnected, 0 missing footprints
- regenerating rules produces byte-identical `.kicad_dru` (no hand-edits)
- `fp-lib-table` has no absolute paths
- no backup/autosave files tracked

## Repair

- Second board file → identify the live one (the one the fab outputs came
  from), delete the other; git history keeps it.
- Hand-edited `.kicad_dru` → port to `03_src/rules/nets.yaml`, regenerate, diff.
- Parity failure (schematic part missing from board) → the generator skipped
  it. Fix the generator to RAISE, then regenerate. Do not hand-place.
